Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: Although the paper is a non-review research article focused on LULC prediction and includes national-scale reconstruction for 1880, its future prediction (2025) is limited to only seven states/UTs—six in Northeast India and Andaman & Nicobar Islands—based on high deforestation rates. Thus, it does not implement explicit national-scale spatial prediction for the future. Additionally, it uses only a single "business-as-usual" (BAU) scenario without ≥2 future scenarios for quantitative comparison, violating two core inclusion criteria: (1) explicit national-scale spatial implementation for future prediction, and (2) implementation of ≥2 future scenarios. These shortcomings meet specific exclusion criteria: “Single-scenario 'business-as-usual' projections” and effectively a regional (not national) future modeling focus.)
